description: Configure Jolly Lobby Track to support a dedicated 'Contractors' visitor group. Navigate to the system settings (often under Setup or Global Settings > Visitor Groups). Locate the existing sample group named 'Members'. Rename this group to 'Contractors' and ensure the option to 'Show on Main Menu' is enabled. Save your changes. The task is complete when a large button labeled 'Contractors' appears on the main application dashboard alongside the standard 'Visitors' button.
